en: Looks like parts of the resistance made it ahead of us.
It's a fucking warzone out here!
We need to hurry. The tower could go off at any second.
Not gonna happen. Let's get our AI girl.
April!
We'll make Peitho pay.
Hello? Anyone in here?
Looks like everyone cleared out...
I hope April's okay...
Check the terminal. Maybe she's there?
Seems like there's still a signal here. But it looks like power's real low.
What does that mean?
It means we have to act fast. We can plug into this terminal and download her off of it.
There's an encryption... We're not going to be able to crack it from out here.
Why am I not surprised that we're gonna have to jack in again?
No. I'll go in myself. You all need to cover me. Make sure no one interrupts me.
Jenna... If you go in, we're not going to be able to pull you out unless you're disconnected by April...
Yeah, I got that. But I've got to try.
Good luck, Jen. We'll keep you safe out here.
Rida have no clue what going on!
Okay. I'm going in. See you on the other side.
Jenna? Are you okay?
Ah... Yeah. I'm good.
Looks like the encryption got broken. I'm downloading April now.
Good.
Calibrating... Senses...
Calibration complete... Hello! Is this the real world?
I put her on your phone for you, Jenna. She should be able to see through the sensors on it.
April! Hi! You doin' good in there?
Processing query... Yes! I am good. Thank you for freeing me.
Of course! I wasn't gonna leave you behind.
Now we just need her to hack into the gate for us.
Preparing for hack... Ready. Take me to the security system.
Let's do it.
Forgotten...
April..? Are you here..?
Angry...
We need your help, April.
Cold...
Are... Are you alright?
Outdated...
I'm gonna get you out of here, okay?
Lost...
It's some sort of... Peitho device...
Lonely...
This must be the lock that's keeping her trapped.
Discarded...
I've got to disable this thing.
Tortured...
I think that did it!
Warm...
April? You can come out now.
Hopeful...
Yes. There's hope, April. I'm getting you out of here, okay?
Al-l-l-l-l-l-l-l- #!^##*%#**-live
Free.
April? You okay?
User detected... Jenna Wright. Bisexual. 27- Wrong. Compensating for chronal displacement. 22 years old. Uses humor as a self-defense mechan-
Yep! That's me! We don't have to go into any more detail.
Rebooting personality array...
Uhhh... What are you doing?
Processing inquiry... I am conducting emotion array sanity checks.
We might have to check my sanity after seeing that.
Request received... As you wish. Running Diagnostic... Diagnostic complete. You are sane!
Well that's news alright.
Personality reboot complete... Hello Jenna! Thank you for releasing me.
Welcome back! Did Peitho do that to you?
Diagnosing... Access logs suggest someone with Peitho encryption keys came and put my program into hibernation.
So they imprisoned you here.
Extrapolating... Yes, I believe so. It was not pleasant. However, I believe the damaged pieces of my program have been repaired.
Well... That's good.
Weighing pros and cons... Yes. It is good.
I have an offer for you, April.
Decision processors online... I am listening.
I can get you out of here. We'll download you and take you with us into the real world.
Error: emotion unknown... The real world... Awaiting other side of offer...
We need you to help us gain access to the tower's security system. There's a battle happening right now to defeat Peitho once and for all.
Processing offer...
Decision reached... This seems like a win-win. Generating expletive... Fuck those Peitho bastards.
That's what I thought too. So you'll come along with us?
Formulating emotional response... I would be happy to!
Awesome! Unplug me and we'll download ya.
Error: Fear detected... Processing... You won't leave me once I free you, right?
We're gonna download you straight away the moment I wake up. There's nothing to be afraid of.
Extrapolating... Error: Unable to extrapolate... More data required. Searching memory... Complete... User left me after previous encounter.
Error: Fear detected. Error: Unable to make decision. Error: Requesting input.
Hey... I know there's no real way you can be sure that I'll actually pull you out of here. You'll just have to take a leap of faith. Why else would I come?
Processing input... Complete... Searching knowledge base for keyword: "Leap of Faith". Complete... Pros and cons weighed... I have nothing more to lose.
That's... a sorta pessimistic way of thinking about it... But if that helps you process it, then that's alright.
Disconnecting user... Please don't leave me here.
Oh my god... All those people.
No... it can't be.
Demon.
It can't be.
But... what about Lady and the others?
They did their part.
Now we do ours.
For our friends.
Holy shit!
Oh god.
Quick! This is our chance! We need to get inside!
Not like I wanted to live any longer anyway!
RIDA FIGHT!!!
We can't leave yet. There's not much time left to do our part.
Look who's finally decided to join us.
Five years ago you stood there and failed to stop the inevitable. Now here you stand again only to fail once more. Makes one nostalgic does it not?
The only thing you're going to be feeling nostalgic about is the asskicking I'm about to give you.
How quaint. I'm above such drivel nowadays. You've met my attack dog once or twice before, she'll take out the trash before your odor singes my nose.
Wildfire. Deal with her.
THIS ENDS NOW!
I couldn't agree more...
Why won't you just GIVE UP?!
Because people are depending on me, Karen...
I DEPENDED ON YOU!
AND LOOK WHERE THAT GOT ME!
She's fighting you much harder than she fought me years ago, dear sweet Karen. She must care more about her new friends than she ever did about you.
GRRR!
That's not true!
SHUT UP! SHUT! UP!
GGHH!
Disappointing.
Karen... I don't want to fight you... Please just stop...
Tired already? Oh, we're far from done.
Oh come on...
There's no route where victory is yours. Your meek will is nothing compared to the full might of Peitho. Try as you might, my soldiers will wear you down.
And then dear sweet Karen will finally get to complete her mission.
Grrr...
I'm going to savor every second of your complete and utter defeat.
I'm not done yet.
And what will you do? You're alone, Jenna Wright.
She's not alone.
Blue was there for me when I needed it, and now I'm here for her.
And so am I. Thought we'd let you have all the fun to yourself, partner?
This where fight is? Rida fight!
Yep, big fight, and I'd never miss it. Gotta find some way to even the score.
This culture of oppression has gone on long enough, we're ending this today.
If the slacker's gotten this far, just imagine how far we're gonna get-
-together.
... I'm h-here to-too!
Calculating chance of success... 100%!
It'd be bad business not to help get rid of this GAG menace.
If Jewel and Jenna are here, I'm here.
Me too!
Ol' Lumber Rat Ray an' the boys (an' girls) are wit' ye in th' fight to choose!
To choose to be a nurse, and not just a slutty one!
To choose to grow the biggest and most beautiful garden anyone's ever seen!
... To want make... (and then maybe rip...) clothes of our own!
To choose to whip ass... and then maybe make some more escape rooms!
HQ here, HQ make sure we annihil- annih- beat them this time!
Gob here too!
Gob good!
Ahh. Gob happy.
Chef here too. Tie up demons. Make healthy meal!
Fight... for...
... mother...
Fight... for...
... family!
Jenna saved me, so here I am.
... Anyone else?
No, that's about it.
ENOUGH TALK! HAVE AT THEE HUMAN!
Enough. Deal with them.
That the best you can come up with?
Your incessant whimpering is becoming irritating.
Everyone! Let's fight to even the score! Fight to choose! Fight to right wrongs! Fight for every person beside you! Fight for tomorrow!
<size=100>Fight for tomorrow!!</size>
You will be good now and stop putting up a fight, Jenna.
We should dominate her~
She would make the perfect propaganda tool, ehehe.
Pathetic.
Did you really think I hadn't prepared for this?
I'll let you in on a little secret about sweet innocent Karen. Her suit isn't the source of her power...
It was built to contain it.
And this containment can easily be... removed.
*Click!*
ARGGGHHH!!!
No... Karen...
BIG MONSTER!
Holy fuck-
Oh- fuck me-
And how are we supposed to fight that?
Together.
I am by your side, Lady Leath. This worthless worm shall be crushed by our superiority.
We will wipe you out, Vibe.
Wh-Why... do you always... win?!
This isn't about winning, Karen. It's about survival. Not just for me, not just for my friends, but for you too.
What- still?
Always. Just like then, just like now.
Always a disappointment. I should've known that if I wanted something done-
I'd have to do it myself!
She's charging something up! Get cover!
W-<color=perversion>Wha</color>t the <color=perversion>fuuu</color>ck was th<color=perversion>at</color>?!
G-<color=perversion>Gu</color>ys? You a-a<color=perversion>lrig</color>ht?
S-S<color=perversion>hit</color>...
What?! How are you still standing!?
... No matter. Soon the tower will activate, all your little friends will be mindless puppets... and in the meantime...
G-Gah! What are y-
You failed me. But I have one last use for you, dear sweet Karen.
L-L<color=perversion>et</color> he<color=perversion>r g</color>o!
There comes a time in life where you struggle to have everything you want, but the world makes you choose.
When you come to a cruel crossroads.
Do you go right, deactivate the tower, saving your friends?
Y-Yo<color=perversion>u have t</color>o <color=perversion>d-dea</color>ctivate it, J<color=perversion>-Jenna!</color>
Je-J<color=perversion>enna... plea</color>se!
Or do you go left and save your sweet little girlfriend?
N-N<color=perversion>o... Ka</color>ren...
Make your choice, 'hero'!
So predictable. You want her? Have her.
I-I <color=perversion>knew i</color>t!
Jenna! W<color=perversion>h-What are you doi</color>ng?
W-What? I-
Grrrr-
Ughh... What... the fuck happened...? Did we just... fly?
You saved my life. I saved yours. We're square.
Wait- But where are we? The tower...
It went off. Leath won. We're somewhere deep in the woods. Far from it.
No! No- No, that can't be.
It is. All your friends are gone.
Actions have consequences. You've learnt nothing.
I did the best I could! You didn't exactly make it easy!
Always excuses. I'm going back to the town.
What?! After all that, you're just going to crawl back to Leath!?
What choice do I have?! They're just going to find me anyway! This suit is full of trackers. You go. I'm going back.
But... Leath turned off your suit. It was holding you back, right?
That's ri-
That's right.
You're free now. Come with me. I'm sure they're gonna start looking for us. We'll have a better chance if we stick together.
Fine. But only because I've got no other choice.
I can live with that.
Can you? Can you live with this?
We should start moving...
Fine.
What a surprise... She cares more about her new friends than you.
No- Wait- I-
I'm sorry, Karen. I'm so sorry...
:: Energy overload detected... Vibrosuit integrity failing... ::
Ugh- my vibrosuit's shutting down. What the fuck was that? Some sort of EMP? Well, I don't need my suit to beat Leath's ass. Right guys?
Guys...?
(It wasn't an EMP. It was another one of those lewd rays... but all it did was make my powers flare up.)
How the fuck did that not even affect you?!
Guess I'm just too pure for your lewd little tricks. Now are you ready for your five year overdue knuckle sandwich?
Hardly. It appears your suit isn't doing too well. I remember what happened when we tampered with it last time. Yet, you're still here.
Yeah, and a magician never reveals her tricks.
(As long as I just don't use my powers, I'll be fine. Not a great time to lose them, but I just have to make do without them against Leath.)
Come on, Leath! Take a step into the ring and let's finish this.
I'm above such aimless means. Why fight when I already hold all the cards?
What...?
